Summary: [TKT-001] Fix broken test pipeline (npm test fails)
Description: `npm test` fails because `jest` executable is missing despite scripts in package.json (lines 13-14).
Acceptance Criteria: `npm test` runs locally and in CI | Jest is installed/configured | At least one app-level test suite exists outside node_modules

Summary: [TKT-002] Remove sensitive logging of auth/user payloads
Description: Auth/admin flows log sensitive payload fields (including password-bearing payload objects) in multiple files (e.g., lib/services/api/admin.ts, lib/context/auth-context.tsx).
Acceptance Criteria: No password/token/PII payload logging in production | Debug logging gated by `__DEV__` | Sensitive fields redacted

Summary: [TKT-003] Disable hardcoded mock mode in production API modules
Description: Critical modules are hardcoded with `USE_MOCK = true` (billing, visitors, maintenance-scheduler, broadcast, parcels), bypassing real backend calls.
Acceptance Criteria: Mock mode is environment-driven | Production defaults to real APIs | Smoke tests confirm live endpoints are used

Summary: [TKT-004] Reconnect requests context to backend APIs
Description: Requests context has API integration commented out and TODO placeholders; operations rely on local storage/mock behavior (lib/context/requests-context.tsx).
Acceptance Criteria: Requests load/create/update/delete/comment operations persist via backend | Local storage is cache only | Data survives app restart and cross-device consistency

Description: APP_CONFIG uses HTTP fallback URLs (`http://13.50.241.81/api`), creating plaintext transport risk if env vars are missing.
Acceptance Criteria: All API fallbacks use HTTPS only | No plaintext HTTP defaults remain | Startup validates missing required env vars

Summary: [TKT-006] Stop sending socket auth token in query string
Description: Notification socket fallback appends auth token in URL query (`token=`), increasing leakage risk via logs/proxies.
Acceptance Criteria: Token is sent only via secure auth payload/headers | Query-string token path removed | Socket auth still supports fallback without URL token

Summary: [TKT-007] Correct timeout error classification in BaseApiService
Description: Timeouts trigger `AbortError` but are reported as `CANCELLED`, misclassifying network timeout behavior and retry logic.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeout errors return TIMEOUT code/message | User cancellation remains distinct | Retry policy uses correct classification

Summary: [TKT-008] Fix Expo config schema violation in app.json
Description: `expo-doctor` reports schema error: android contains unsupported `usesCleartextTraffic` key in app.json.
Acceptance Criteria: `expo-doctor` schema checks pass | Cleartext setting moved to supported native/plugin config if needed

Summary: [TKT-009] Align dependencies with Expo SDK patch requirements
Description: `expo-doctor` flags version drift for expo/expo-constants/expo-font/expo-router and warns against direct `@types/react-native` install.
Acceptance Criteria: All dependency checks pass in `expo-doctor` | Required package versions aligned with SDK | `@types/react-native` removed

Summary: [TKT-010] Add role guard to building employee layout
Description: Building employee tab layout lacks auth/role guard in route layout (app/(buildingEmployee)/_layout.tsx), increasing deep-link access risk.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized users are redirected before rendering protected screens | Deep links enforce role checks consistently

Summary: [TKT-011] Fix visitor pass permission logic/message mismatch
Description: Code permits only management role but error message says management or admin can create visitor passes (lib/context/modules/property.ts).
Acceptance Criteria: Behavior and message are aligned | If admin is allowed, permission checks/tests updated | If not allowed, message corrected

Summary: [TKT-012] Resolve stale hook dependency warnings in modal screens
Description: Lint reports React hook dependency warnings in modal screens (`request-details`, `conversation-detail`) indicating potential stale closures.
Acceptance Criteria: `npm run lint` has zero hook dependency warnings | Modal state updates are deterministic under rerenders

Summary: [TKT-013] Standardize status mapping across building employee screens
Description: Status mapping rules differ between building employee dashboard and jobs screens, leading to inconsistent UI state interpretation.
Acceptance Criteria: A shared status-mapping utility is used across screens | Same backend status maps to same UI status everywhere

Summary: [TKT-014] Restore or formally defer TypeScript strict mode
Description: Repository docs claim strict mode, but tsconfig has `strict: false`.
Acceptance Criteria: Either strict mode is enabled and passing, or docs include an approved migration plan with tracked debt tickets

Summary: [TKT-015] Update README to match actual project structure
Description: README documents `src/` structure, but repository currently has no `src/` directory.
Acceptance Criteria: README structure reflects current code layout (`app/`, `lib/`, etc.) | Onboarding instructions remain accurate

Summary: [TKT-016] Normalize encoding and remove mojibake text artifacts
Description: Several files show encoding artifacts/misrendered characters in docs/logs/UI strings.
Acceptance Criteria: Files are UTF-8 normalized | No mojibake appears in UI strings/docs/log output
